# ninja build file for plan805-probe with gcc compiler

# includes
includes = -I../include -I../路径 中文

# defines
defines = -DDEBUG=1 -DVERSION=2

# cflags
cflags = -O2 -g3 --custom-flag

# rules
rule as
    command = C:/__plan805_probe__/tc/as.exe -I../include -I../路径 中文 -O2 -g3 --custom-flag -o$out $in
    description = Assembling $in

rule cc
    command = "C:/tools with space/bin/cc.exe" -c -I../include -I../路径 中文 -DDEBUG=1 -DVERSION=2 -O2 -g3 --custom-flag -o$out $in
    description = Compiling $in

rule link
    command = C:/__plan805_probe__/tc/gcc.exe -o$out $in $ldflags $libs
    description = Linking $out

rule lib
    command = C:/__plan805_probe__/tc/ar.exe rcs $out $in
    description = Building library $out

# build objects for target app
build main.o: cc ../src/main.c
# target executable
build app: link main.o
# build objects for target math
build math.o: cc ../math/math.c
# target library
build libmath.a: lib math.o

# build objects for target t
build test.o: cc ../t/test.c
# target executable
build t: link test.o
